## Does it fit the scope?

This library covers the boring parts *around* a desktop application: paths,
single instance, autostart, menu entry, session, tray detection, logs. It does
not draw UI, does not implement a tray of its own, and has no runtime
dependencies.

- [ ] It needs no new runtime dependency
- [ ] It works without root and stays inside the user's home directory
- [ ] It can be tested without a display or special hardware
